facts.business: Bata India Limited is the largest footwear retailer in India with an extensive store network, nationwide delivery, and distribution network, offering a diverse portfolio of quality products across various price points and categories.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure contracted but not provided for

guidance_or_targets.statement: Company will act as a regional hub for design and development, conceptualising and curating collections, working closely with Bata Global design team, focusing on the needs of India and similar retail markets.
guidance_or_targets.value: Regional hub for design and development

guidance_or_targets.statement: Premiumisation of product portfolio and expansion in the market share of premium category, portfolio freshness, scaling up digital channels and productivity enhancement will continue to be the priorities along with investments in brands and stores.
guidance_or_targets.value: Premiumisation, digital scaling, productivity enhancement, brand and store investments

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts

key_risks: Macroeconomic factors like inflation, unemployment rate, distribution of income, social constraints regulating discretionary spending
Regulatory e-commerce policies shaping growth strategies
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include ultimate holding company Compass Holdco Limited, parent entity BATA (BN) B.V., subsidiaries Bata Properties Limited and Way Finders Brands Limited, fellow subsidiaries across multiple countries, key management personnel, and enterprise in which director is interested (Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co. till 3rd August 2024). Transactions include CSR fund contributions to Bata India Limited Gratuity Fund and Pension Fund.
